nodes.title: Integration 76's pre-gate stopped on the kon layout browser suite with 'page.evaluate: Target crashed' after 581 s. Memory was free (15 GB); the disk allowance was 99% used (695 MB free), mostly two read-only judge checkouts of 4 GB each and 347 temporary test folders. With 6.5 GB freed the same suite passed. A browser crash in a layout suite is a disk signal first; judge checkouts are removed when their judges finish.

A worker restart of the main session killed integration 76's background chain (started with nohup setsid) partway through. The restart followed a get_session call on another session. Remote session calls (get_session, list_sessions, send_message) are not made while a gate, a release, a paid run or judges are running locally.
